title: Longest Unique Substring
description:
Return the length of the longest contiguous substring that contains no repeated characters. The comparison is case-sensitive, and the empty string has length `0`.

Aim for a linear-time solution. For example, `"dvdf"` has answer `3` because `"vdf"` is the longest substring with unique characters.

solution.explanation: A sliding window tracks the current substring with unique characters. When a character repeats inside the window, move the start just past its previous position. Update the best length as each character is processed.
